name: Heralded amplification of time-bin and Fock-state photonic qubits at 1550 nm with MoSi SNSPDs below 2.5 K
plain_name: Boost a lossy light-based qubit and confirm success with superconducting photon counters
description: Run an all-fibre telecom heralded qubit amplifier (SPDC heralded source, ancilla preparation, Bell-state measurement) and record four-fold coincidences with fibre-coupled MoSi superconducting nanowire detectors (70 % efficiency at 1550 nm, 80 ns recovery) held below 2.5 K in a two-stage closed-cycle cryocooler.
keywords: Boost a lossy light-based qubit and confirm success with superconducting photon counters

sources.citation: Heralded amplification of photonic qubits (Bruno et al., arXiv:1507.03210; Optics Express 24, 125-133, 2016)

reported_equipment: MoSi superconducting nanowire single photon detectors (SNSPD)

requirements.rationale: The MoSi SNSPDs reach 70 % efficiency when held below 2.5 K.
Each detector is self-aligned to a single-mode optical fibre, so fibre optical access to the cold stage is required.
At least the two Bell-state-measurement detectors (D2 and D3) need their own RF readout lines; the heralding/output detector adds more.
The nanowires are current-biased and read out electrically.
Optional: the detectors were designed for a two-stage closed-cycle cryocooler; a bath cryostat below 2.5 K would also work.

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
